claim: From S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval or the S3 Intelligent-Tiering Archive Access tier, typical retrieval times are: Expedited 1–5 minutes for objects under 250 megabytes, Standard 3–5 hours (Minutes–5 hours with Batch Operations) and Bulk 5–12 hours.

qualifiers.scope: S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval or S3 Intelligent-Tiering Archive Access
qualifiers.condition: typical times; the Expedited time is for objects under 250 megabytes

evidence.quote: | S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval or S3 Intelligent-Tiering Archive Access | 1–5 minutes | Minutes–5 hours | 3–5 hours | 5–12 hours |
evidence.table_header: | Storage class or tier | Expedited | Standard (with Batch Operations) | Standard (without Batch Operations) | Bulk |

evidence.quote: Objects under 250 megabytes in size are typically made available within 1–5 minutes, and objects 250 megabytes or larger in size are typically retrieved with up to 300 megabytes per second of retrieval throughput.
